summary: Implemented workflow code export functionality with three export formats (single TypeScript file, npm package, GitHub Gist). Created CodeExporter service with exportAsFile, exportAsPackage, and exportAsGist methods. Created packageTemplates.ts for generating package.json, tsconfig.json, README.md, and test scaffolds. Built ExportDialog.tsx component with format selection, dependency/test options, validation warnings, and export history tracking. Integrated Export button into WorkflowEditor header. All exports include proper validation, dependency listing, and complete in under 2 seconds. Added 80 tests (63 backend + 17 frontend) covering all functionality.
